memory_update.text: PWR is the reference leader for grid EPC and utility-services backlog, useful as a benchmark but not the main underfollowed target.
MYRG should remain in the underfollowed lane as a relatively pure public specialty electrical contractor for transmission, distribution, substations, clean energy, and emergency restoration.

PRIM should remain in the underfollowed lane as a broader infrastructure contractor with direct power-delivery and Utilities segment exposure; verify how much of growth is transmission/substation versus lower-margin distribution or storm work.
PLPC is the most interesting second-order hardware candidate in this pass; evidence to verify is whether Energy segment order intake leads contractor backlog conversion.

Layer 1C should search beyond direct contractors for listed suppliers of conductor, insulators, pole-line hardware, substation connectors, fleet equipment, workforce training, inspection, and permitting/software chokepoints.

node: Grid EPC, transmission construction, and utility services
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the grid EPC, transmission construction, and utility-services node. Quanta Services is the reference anchor because it is the dominant scaled listed contractor with record backlog, but the higher-priority discovery lane contains MYR Group, Primoris Services, and Preformed Line Products. MYR and Primoris are public specialty contractors with direct transmission, distribution, substation, and utility-services exposure. PLPC is a second-order hardware supplier whose formed-wire, connectors, spacers, dampers, insulators, and line-protection products can move ahead of visible construction revenue. Claims are research inputs only, not trading recommendations.
